problem_statement: Build a brand-new /portfolio page from scratch on this React (CRA + react-router-dom) personal-website template. The route /portfolio does not exist yet (baseline renders empty). Construct a full portfolio page that reuses the site's existing design system (purple #6200ea accent, Montserrat/Roboto fonts, sticky navbar, rounded project cards) and adds ONE real interaction: a project-category filter (All / Web / Mobile / Design). Clicking a category must narrow the visible project cards AND update the status heading to reflect the selected category and the count. The page must be responsive with zero horizontal overflow on mobile (390px).
required_content: A sticky navbar reusing the site's .navbar styling with a Home / Back-to-site link and a Portfolio brand label
An intro paragraph describing the project collection

A category filter bar with four buttons: All, Web, Mobile, Design (each a real <button> carrying a unique data-filter attribute; the active button uses purple #6200ea fill with white text, inactive buttons are white with a #6200ea border and text, pill-shaped border-radius 32px)

A status heading (h3) that reads 'Showing All Projects (6)' by default and updates on filter click to 'Showing Web Projects (2)', 'Showing Mobile Projects (2)', or 'Showing Design Projects (1)' with the correct count

Exactly SIX project cards, each with an h3 title, a one-line summary, and technology tags, reusing the existing .project-card / .project-technology visual language. Use these exact six projects: (1) 'Personal Website Template' [Web] - 'A responsive personal website template built with React.' tags React.js/HTML/CSS; (2) 'QR Code Generator' [Web] - 'A containerised QR code generator service.' tags Python/Docker; (3) 'Task Tracker Dashboard' [Web] - 'A dashboard for tracking daily tasks and progress.' tags React.js/Node.js; (4) 'Fitness Companion App' [Mobile] - 'A cross-platform mobile app for workout logging.' tags React Native/Expo; (5) 'Grocery List Mobile App' [Mobile] - 'An offline-first shopping list app for phones.' tags Flutter/Dart; (6) 'Brand Identity Kit' [Design] - 'A complete brand identity and logo system.' tags Figma/Illustrator
Clicking a filter button narrows the visible cards to that category (Web=3, Mobile=2, Design=1) and updates the status heading; the 'All' button (6) restores the full set
design_constraints: Reuse the site's purple accent #6200ea (rgb(98,0,234)) with #3700b3 (rgb(55,0,179)) hover; card/nav on white #ffffff background; body text black #000000 with #555555 (rgb(85,85,85)) secondary text
Reuse Montserrat headings / Roboto body fonts (via App.css); project cards use a subtle shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0px 4px 6px and 16px corner radius
Reuse the sticky .navbar and .project-card / .project-technology visual system; filter buttons are pill-shaped (border-radius 32px)
Mobile (<=440px): cards go full width, zero horizontal overflow
